correctness.rationale: Explicit spectral projection conjugation supplies all diagonal fibers; orbit-stabilizer counts q^{e_X(c)} over every finite field. Verified direct matrix examples over F2, F3 and two nonchain incidence posets; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The object is the natural uniform ensemble of idempotents in finite triangular/incidence algebras; pairwise commutation is a fundamental algebraic invariant. A sharp q^{-kappa n^2} n^{-mu} law with explicit positive theta coefficients answers how rare joint commutation becomes and exhibits balanced common-eigenspace mechanisms. It supplies exact all-n q-color counting and a sharp nontrivial asymptotic, beyond a single-idempotent formula or a routine finite census.
